title: Rate Manual: Premium Discounts and Reductions Carried by the Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan Letters
content:
Three reductions of premium are carried in the rate manual for Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies: a household discount where another adult in the household holds a Ridgecrest supplement, a discount for paying a full year in advance, and a flat reduction each billing period for paying by bank transfer. The first two are percentages; the third is an amount in USD.

| Policy | Household discount | Annual payment discount | Bank transfer reduction each billing period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 5 per cent | 4 per cent | 1.50 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 5 per cent | 4 per cent | 1.50 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 7 per cent | 4 per cent | 2.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 5 per cent | 4 per cent | 1.50 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 7 per cent | 4 per cent | 2.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 12 per cent | 6 per cent | 2.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 12 per cent | 6 per cent | 2.00 |

### How the columns differ

The household discount is the largest of the three and varies most across the letters: 5 per cent on Plan A, Plan B and Plan K, 7 per cent on Plan D and Plan N, and 12 per cent on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.

The annual payment discount stands at 4 per cent on Plan A, Plan B, Plan D, Plan K and Plan N, and at 6 per cent on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.

The bank transfer reduction is not a percentage but a flat amount taken each billing period: 1.50 on Plan A, Plan B and Plan K, and 2.00 on Plan D, Plan N, Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.
